description: This Java class defines an entity event-condition-action (ECA) rule for the Apache OFBiz framework. It processes XML configuration elements to set up rules that trigger actions based on conditions when certain entity events occur.

classes.name: EntityEcaRule
classes.description: Represents an entity event-condition-action rule, parsing XML configuration and evaluating conditions/actions on entity events.

methods.name: EntityEcaRule
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the rule based on an XML element describing the rule configuration.

methods.name: getEntityName
methods.description: Returns the name of the entity this rule applies to.

methods.name: getOperationName
methods.description: Returns the operation name associated with this rule.

methods.name: getEventName
methods.description: Returns the event name that triggers this rule.

methods.name: getRunOnError
methods.description: Indicates whether this rule should run on error conditions.

methods.name: getActionsAndSets
methods.description: Returns the list of actions and field sets associated with this rule.

methods.name: getConditions
methods.description: Returns the list of conditions for this rule.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates the rule: checks conditions and executes actions if conditions are true.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Deprecated method to enable or disable the rule.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the rule is enabled.
